<reason>CON won by making the comparison decidable: solidarity as revealed choices toward sharing, distrust as what never won a live decision. PRO’s hierarchy, closed-banks, and self-insurance story stayed coherent but kept relabeling every transfer, re-election, forbearance, and later common debt, so it could not show distrust cut deeper. CON’s falsifiable counterfactuals beat PRO’s “test cannot lose” charge; the clipped R2 was a real but limited cost.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>CON’s turn of 2015’s re-election and 2018 maturity extensions against coercion/self-insurance, then treating PRO’s Italian-spreads reply as shared fate.</best_rebuttal>
